mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 65 degrees at Verona Community Park under a full moon. The ISS will pass overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona reports that a portion of Highway M near the future Aldi site will be closed from October 5 through October 7 for road improvements. Please plan to use Old PB, East Verona Avenue, and South Main Street as your detour.

There is plenty to do in Verona today, including live music at Bailey's Run and the Verona Fall Fest at Hometown USA Festival Park. Tomorrow, you can head to the Dane County Farmer's Market at the Capitol Square or enjoy music at Paddy Mac's.
In our weekly police report, on September 5, officers investigated a local trend where vehicles were found with slices of cheese on their windshields, identified as a social media prank.
The Culver's of Verona location is currently closed for a remodel, so today's flavor is unavailable. We look forward to their return.
